_comment: Classification of all 87 previously-unmapped java grammar node types. Each is either INTERNAL (container/literal/keyword whose children are processed separately - correctly emits nothing) or GAP (should emit something but currently does not).

internal_correctly_silent._description: Containers, wrappers, keywords, and grouping nodes whose children are walked separately
internal_correctly_silent._reason: Pure containers/wrappers - their named children are visited independently by the main walk and classified there

literals_correctly_silent._description: Literal values - they ARE the data, never symbols or relationships
literals_correctly_silent._reason: Values consumed by their parent expressions, not independent constructs

keywords_tokens._description: Reserved words that appear as leaf nodes - not constructs
keywords_tokens._reason: Comments are consumed by javadoc extraction at the declaration level, not independently

handled_by_existing_code._description: Types that DO produce emissions through existing handler code paths
handled_by_existing_code._reason: Either produce emissions through existing walk paths OR are sub-expressions consumed by parent handlers
handled_by_existing_code._status: NEEDS VERIFICATION - confirm each actually produces expected output on test fixtures
